data.title: 幽灵鲨 · 围巾一角
data.description: 她按住被风吹起的围巾，侧身靠近，让另一端也替你挡一点风。她望着你，笑得很轻。
data.action: 扶住围巾，侧头对镜头微笑
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Under the moody amber halo of an old iron streetlamp on a deserted seaside promenade, Specter catches the fluttering end of her heavy knit scarf in the ocean wind, leaning close to the viewer with an intimate, mocking smile. Sea spray mists the glistening wet pavement, while distant lighthouse flashes and crashing dark breakers create a dramatic nocturnal maritime backdrop.
